# SwipeNode

SwipeNode is verified engineering knowledge infrastructure for AI agents.
Status: Private Beta.

Managed Knowledge: https://knowledge.swipenode.dev/
Customer source, CLI, documentation and public Trust: https://github.com/sirToby99/swipenode

Customer Claims, Evidence, Verification History, Audit, Provenance, private
Packs and engineering artifacts remain customer-hosted. Managed Knowledge
distributes public maintained Pack and release metadata; it does not ingest
customer engineering state.

For binary installation, use only scripts/install.sh together with
scripts/verify-software-trust.py as documented in README.md. That path must
authenticate software Trust metadata, release-key authorization, the signed
checksum manifest and archive hash before the candidate binary is extracted or
executed. Machine-readable release onboarding is in release-discovery.json.

Start with README.md, docs/INSTALL.md and docs/VERIFY_JETSON.md. Verification
outcomes are VERIFIED, CONFLICT and UNVERIFIED. Fetch and revalidation are
explicit operations, not a background monitor.
